title: Absence of generic character-supported constituents in localized torsion cohomology at infinite split level for KHT Shimura varieties with irreducible residual Galois representation
source_title: Galois irreducibility implies cohomology freeness for KHT Shimura varieties
author: Pascal Boyer
difficulty_reason: The final generic-constituent exclusion depends on locating every relevant torsion class in the correct integral resolution maps, rather than only on characteristic-zero degeneration. Section3.1 proves the first-torsion degree formula by tracing strictness and nontrivial torsion cokernels through the Harris-Taylor resolutions. Section3.2 transfers that analysis to the character-supported nearby-cycle graded pieces before the non-generic reduction argument applies; this newly retained integral analysis is the nonroutine obligation.
